main_text.p: tissimus est,ideo manus obtinuit? ut Aristoteles, Fer-nelius & alij. Apud Aristot.l.4.departib. animal.cap. 10.Physiolog.l.i.c.2[?].
2. An bruta animalia Ratione utantur? Plutarchus libro prop.
3. Visio quomodo fiat? Extramittendone, ut Platonici & Optici statuunt: an vero recipiendo? ut nobilisimi Peripatetici. Galenus passim : Velcurio vero summatim & eleg.lib.4.Comm.Phys.c.7.
4. An Intellectus nofter sit instar tabulæ rasæ? Vt supponit aduers.Plat.philosophia Peripatetica:3.de Anima.t.14.
5. An item liceat intelligere sine Phantasmatis? Vt Theologi aduersus Peripateticos philos. Aristotelis huius rei elegans loc.libro de Memoria et Reminiscentia ex 3.de Anima, t.30.
6. An quoq; Aristoteles Fœminam quasi marem lę sum recte dixerit? 2.de generat.an.c.3. Doctiss.Taurell. Comm.Villan.col.26.27.
main_text.head: METEOROLOGICA.
main_text.p: 7. Arbores reddi odoratas inquiunt, in quas Iris, arcus cælestis decubuit. Vtrum verum hoc sit,an falsum? Ex problem.Ænigm.est.
8. An Odorata omnia Calida sint? Apud Aristot. & Galen.
main_text.head: ACROAMATICA.
main_text.p: 9. An quodlibet: fiat ex quolibet:& quodlibet corrupatur in quodlibet? I. Ἀκροάσ.φυσ.5[?].
main_text.head: METAPHYSICA.
main_text.p: 10. Ex Contrarijs Mundus, Ciuitas, Generatio, & Artes an recte constare dicantur? Libro de Mund. ad Alex.cap.6.
11. Principia & Caussæ,an eadem, vel diuersa? 2. Phys.t.3.5.Metaphys.t.1.

page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout. Greek reference after item 9 is only partly legible: its letters are copied as best read. The reading "l.i.c.2" in item 1 and the word "lę" in item 6 are doubtful. The section headings METEOROLOGICA, ACROAMATICA and METAPHYSICA are set as level 2 parts of the question list.
